limits: Actual host click/key records are aligned with runtime state; the analyzer never invokes gameplay actions.
Click records occur after mouse release. Baselines precede the record by at least 0.25s; settled samples start at +0.18s and stop before the next input.
Only sampled inherited widget properties are asserted present; no unsupported claim that every UWidget object was enumerated.
Media failure was not deliberately injected; media-open/play/end behavior and empty error flags are observed.
No packaged executable or cross-relaunch saved custom camera pose is claimed.
